source.title: The Only Song I Know...
source.description:
You fancy yourself a hero of the Dawn, eh? I've seen our greatest soldiers get rolled over by Kel'Thuzad's plebes! How well could someone so clueless possibly fare in Naxxramas?

<Wilhelm sighs.>

Bah, what choice do I got? You're the best I can do; I may as well help you.

Omarion left me with one recipe. It's the only song I know... I can make a few variations of these pants; you just gotta supply the materials.
source.objective: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants you to bring him 2 Frozen Runes, 2 Essence of Water, 2 Blue Sapphires and 30 gold pieces.
source.progress: You haven't run into Omarion, have you?
source.completion:
<Wilhelm wipes the sweat from his brow.>

That's some hard work! Enjoy the pants, <class>. At least you'll die in a clean pair now.
